text: 某种沉重而压迫的力量向你袭来，让你喘不过气。它把你压倒在布满卵石的沙地上。究竟是真实发生，还是你的想象？
这次攻击的意志为80。与你自己的意志进行对抗检定：若你获胜，前往120；若你落败，前往162。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 119
text: Something presses down upon you, something oppressive and stifling. It forces you to your knees in the pebbly sand. Is this real or some creation of your imagination?
This attack has a POW of 80. Make an opposed roll with your own POW. If you win, go to 120. If you lose, go to 162.
